title: test-wsl2-llm template configuration
description: A batch template for running one isolated WSL2 Codex test for each question, model, and repetition.

prompt_template.description: Prompt text shared by every question. Substitute scalar question fields with {{ field }}; nested expressions and Jinja expressions are not supported.

questions.description: Questions to expand in YAML order. Each id must be unique at runtime.

model.description: One Codex model, optionally written as MODEL:EFFORT. The effort defaults to medium. A model from user defaults or the template-run --model option may supply this instead.

models.description: Models to compare, each optionally written as MODEL:EFFORT. This list takes precedence over model when both are present.

repeat.description: Number of repetitions for each model/question cell. Existing result pairs are skipped unless --force is used.

threads.description: Maximum number of model/question/repetition jobs run concurrently.

title.description: Markdown report heading. When omitted, template runs derive a heading from the question id and question field.

marketplaces.description: Windows marketplace directories or Git repository URLs to make available in each isolated WSL run.

plugins.description: Plugin selectors to install in each run, such as NAME@MARKETPLACE.

mcp_servers.description: Names of MCP servers to copy from the Windows user's Codex config.toml. Names are resolved at execution time.

copy_files.description: Windows files copied into the root of each fresh WSL workspace before Codex starts. Relative paths are relative to this YAML file.

copy_back.description: Workspace-relative files or shell-style globs copied beside each report after Codex finishes. Missing matches are reported but do not fail collection.

validators.description: Local checks applied after execution and copy-back. Every check must pass for the run to succeed.

environment.description: Optional Windows environment filtering applied before every WSL launch.

distro.description: WSL distribution name. Omit to use the WSL default distribution.

wsl_parent.description: Existing directory in WSL under which temporary run roots are created.

output.description: Windows result stem or .md/.yaml path. A question id, model selector, and repetition suffix are appended for template jobs. Omit to use a timestamped default.

overwrite.description: Whether existing report pairs may be replaced. The template-run --force option sets this for the invocation.

sandbox.description: Codex sandbox policy for the isolated workspace.

network.description: Whether network access is allowed in the workspace sandbox.

approvals_reviewer.description: Reviewer used by the Codex approval policy.

auth_source.description: Readable WSL-side Codex auth.json source copied into the isolated run CODEX_HOME.

pricing_file.description: Windows pricing YAML path. Omit to use the bundled model-pricing.yaml.

progress_lines.description: Number of recent Codex progress lines shown while each job runs.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum Codex execution time per job in seconds. Use null to disable the timeout.

max_copy_back_files.description: Maximum number of files collected per job, including files matched by globs.

cleanup.description: Remove each temporary WSL run root after reports and copied-back files are collected. Set false to retain it for connect/continue.

prompt.description: Accepted for compatibility with a saved run configuration, but ignored when prompt_template is present.

prompt_file.description: Accepted for compatibility with a saved run configuration, but its prompt is ignored when prompt_template is present.

question.description: One question's scalar substitution values. Besides id and copy_back, property names must be identifier-shaped and values must be strings, numbers, or booleans.

id.description: Unique result and selection identifier. It must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, periods, underscores, or hyphens.

copy_back.description: Question-specific copy-back additions. A string beginning with '-' removes a matching shared pattern or earlier addition.

additionalProperties.description: A scalar value available to prompt_template as {{ field }}.

unset.description: Environment variable names removed case-insensitively before WSL launches.

path_remove.description: Case-insensitive Windows PATH prefixes or shell-style globs removed before WSL launches.
